subject: Introduce GoogleTest for Valkey unit testing (#3241)
reason: The change migrates Valkey's unit tests from the in-house framework to GoogleTest: CI workflow updates, CMake/Makefile plumbing, vendored gtest-parallel, and test_*.c -> test_*.cpp rewrites. The only runtime-source edits are mechanical C++-compatibility changes with no behavioral effect: testOnly* wrappers exposing static internals (dead code in a server run), parameter renames of C++ keywords (template, class), #ifndef __cplusplus guards in headers, a semantically identical SDS_HDR_VAR cast, and a reorder of the stream struct's fields (in-memory layout only, never serialized by offset).
